name: AAPM Grand Challenge on Deep Generative Modeling for Medical Image Statistics
description: A grand-challenge style evaluation for generative modeling methods to learn and reproduce medical image statistics for medical imaging tasks.
evaluation_method: Distribution-matching and perceptual metrics (e.g., FID), plus task-specific statistical similarity tests and human expert evaluation
reputation: An established grand-challenge style evaluation in the medical imaging community (AAPM) with reputable standing for evaluating generative modeling in medical imaging.
notes: Medical dataset — access and use often restricted; potential PHI/privacy constraints. Non-LLM benchmark focused on image statistics and realism; metrics and difficulty vary by specific task within the challenge.
